Eighteen cards have narrow foundation_only evidence, 102 are unsupported, and none are marked precise. Foundation evidence applies only to the exact technical term/pattern claimed; no task mechanics, custom wording, dimensions, timing, repetitions, age suitability, workload, safety arrangement, adaptations or efficacy are approved by this source. DR-005 relay-baton handover, DR-028 table-tennis forehand, DR-053 gallop, DR-049 badminton «удар снизу», and DR-052 table-tennis «блок» remain unsupported/unresolved in this retrieved source. The grades 1–4 program was not retrieved.
